bajada: a living atlas of the nervous system
aviso_titulo: The models are approximate shapes for now.
aviso_texto: They are there to locate and recognise each structure; definitive modelling is in progress. Every entry states the status of its model.

sin_traducir: Translation pending: part of this text is in Spanish
portada_lead: An open-access interactive atlas that presents neuroanatomy and neurophysiology together. Every structure states what it is, what it does, the level of detail at which it is represented, and where each statement comes from. No neuroscience background is needed: technical terms link to their explanation.
portada_estado: Work in progress, in use. Entries stay as drafts until the author verifies every statement against its source; each entry shows its status. Content is written in Spanish; entries not yet translated are shown in Spanish and labelled as such.
regiones_texto: Each region is read part by part; its parts appear once you enter. Those with a model can be rotated and tapped.
glosario_texto: Foundational entries: the concepts the other entries take for granted, explained with the same rigour.
no_encontrada_texto: The structure may go by another name, or it may not be published yet.
pie: Content under CC BY-SA 4.0 · A teaching resource, schematic by design: not a clinical or surgical reference.
meta_portada: Open-access interactive atlas of neuroanatomy and neurophysiology together, with no prior background assumed.
sistemas_texto: A real function runs through several structures. Each system shows the whole circuit and links to every part.
